facts.text: I need four characters for a fantasy RPG game: a reluctant hero main character, two supporting friend characters, and one evil villain who has emerged after a long dormant period to execute a plan for world domination.
I want character descriptions that include each character's name, age, race, personality, and backstory.
I want to generate RPG-style quests when I ask.
I want quests to be short stories that include a problem the three hero characters need to overcome.
I distinguish between main story quests and side quests.
A main story quest should advance the primary plot of the game.
The main story quest should involve finding and defeating the evil villain Malakar.
A side quest should not advance the main plot.
Side quests may allude to the effects Malakar has had on the world and reveal lore about past events.
Malakar should not appear at any point during a side quest.
Quests should be generated in chronological order.
Quests should respect events, character development, and world-building that occur in previous quests.
When I ask to generate a new quest, I specify whether it is a main story quest or a side quest.
If I do not specify, the quest should be assumed to be a side quest.
I asked to generate a main story quest.
I asked to generate a side quest.
I asked to generate another side quest.
I asked to generate a side quest.
